Nadia Ruiz (CSM): weekly health for Holloway 10: p95/p99 by route+model, streaming vs sync. flagged a p99 tail on Wednesday evening.
Owen Blake (SRE): 7d aggregates: chat.completions @ rw-chat-3 -> streaming p95=230ms p99=710ms; sync p95=390ms p99=1.02s.
Owen Blake (SRE): embed.text @ rw-embed-2 -> sync p95=50ms p99=140ms (no streaming used).
Owen Blake (SRE): rerank @ rw-rank-1 -> streaming p95=200ms p99=560ms; sync p95=275ms p99=690ms.
Nadia Ruiz (CSM): summary: streaming lowers p95 but tail still problematic on chat; appears tied to Wed 18:00-18:30 window.
Tom Bennett (Holloway Eng): yes we ran a customer demo at 18:15 that coincides with the spike. users noticed slow replies.
Owen Blake (SRE): checked autoscaler logs 18:05-18:35 UTC concurrency +34%, queue depth peaked 72, autoscaler scaled but ~40-50s lag.
InfraBot: alert: high_queue_depth service=chat.completions peak_queue=72 duration=1200s link=https://telemetry/alerts/8791
Samira Khan (Onboarding): small note: some canary can beps routed to rw-small-beta during that window (~10% traffic). rw-small-beta p99 sync ~1.4s under load.
Owen Blake (SRE): action: I'll cap canary to 3% during 14:00-02:00 UTC and add a 30s synthetic check for chat.
Nadia Ruiz (CSM): I'll schedule a 25-min enablement demo showing streaming benefits (recommend concurrency=3). will include cost/spend note: canary churn increased CPUE by ~11% last month.
Tom Bennett (Holloway Eng): appreciated. if p99 <750ms by next Tues demo we'll be good for renewal convo.
Owen Blake (SRE): quick command used to pull metrics:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --start=1700000000 --end=1700600000 --group-by="route,model,streaming_mode" --quantiles=0.95,0.99
```
Nadia Ruiz (CSM): will post updated p95/p99 snapshot after routing tweak. closing for now unless numbers persist. :thumbsup:
Tom Bennett (Holloway Eng): thanks team :pray:
Samira Khan (Onboarding): noted, will coordinate canary schedule with Holloway eng.
